 from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
 
 from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistItem, ComplianceChecklist, ComplianceTemplate
 from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistStatus as ModelChecklistStatus
 from src.backend.schemas.compliance import (
     ChecklistItemUpdate,
     ComplianceTemplateCreate,
     ComplianceTemplateRead,
     InstantiateChecklistRequest,
 )
 
 
 def _template_to_read(template: ComplianceTemplate) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
     items_data = []
     if template.items:
         try:
             items_data = json.loads(template.items) if isinstance(template.items, str) else template.items
         except Exception:
             items_data = []
     return ComplianceTemplateRead(
         id=template.id,
         name=template.name,
         standard_code=template.standard_code,
         category=template.category,
         is_active=template.is_active,
         items=items_data,
         created_at=template.created_at,
     )
 
 
 def list_templates_service(
     db: Session,
     page: int = 1,
     page_size: int = 20,
     standard_code: str | None = None,
     is_active: bool | None = None,
 ) -> tuple[list[ComplianceTemplateRead], int, int, int]:
     query = db.query(ComplianceTemplate)
     if standard_code:
         query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.standard_code == standard_code)
     if is_active is not None:
         query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.is_active == is_active)
 
     total = query.count()
     templates = (
         query.order_by(ComplianceTemplate.created_at.desc())
         .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
         .limit(page_size)
         .all()
     )
 
     items = [_template_to_read(t) for t in templates]
     return items, total, page, page_size
 
 
 def create_template_service(
     db: Session,
     data: ComplianceTemplateCreate,
     actor_id: uuid.UUID,
 ) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
     template = ComplianceTemplate(
         name=data.name,
         standard_code=data.standard_code,
         category=data.category,
         is_active=True,
         items=json.dumps([item.model_dump() for item in data.items]),
     )
     db.add(template)
     db.commit()
     db.refresh(template)
     return _template_to_read(template)
 
 
 def get_template_service(db: Session, template_id: uuid.UUID) -> ComplianceTemplateRead | None:
     template = db.query(ComplianceTemplate).filter(ComplianceTemplate.id == template_id).first()
     if not template:
         return None
     return _template_to_read(template)
 
 
 def _recalculate_checklist_status(checklist: ComplianceChecklist) -> None:
     items = checklist.items
     if not items:
         checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
         checklist.completed_at = None
         return
 
     total = len(items)
     completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_completed)
     mandatory_items = [item for item in items if item.is_mandatory]
-    mandatory_completed = sum(1 for item in mandatory_items if item.is_completed)
+    mandatory_incomplete = sum(1 for item in mandatory_items if not item.is_completed)
 
-    if completed == 0:
-        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
-        checklist.completed_at = None
-    elif mandatory_completed < len(mandatory_items):
+    if mandatory_incomplete > 0:
         checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value
         checklist.completed_at = None
     elif completed == total:
         checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.COMPLETED.value
-        checklist.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        checklist.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
+    elif completed == 0:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
     else:
         checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value
         checklist.completed_at = None
 
 
 def _checklist_to_read(checklist: ComplianceChecklist) -> dict:
     items = checklist.items
     total = len(items) if items else 0
     completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_completed) if items else 0
     progress = (completed / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0.0
 
     return {
         "id": checklist.id,
         "project_id": checklist.project_id,
         "template_id": checklist.template_id,
         "status": checklist.status,
         "completed_at": checklist.completed_at,
         "created_at": checklist.created_at,
         "template_name": checklist.template.name if checklist.template else None,
         "template_standard_code": checklist.template.standard_code if checklist.template else None,
         "progress_percent": round(progress, 2),
         "items": [
             {
                 "id": item.id,
                 "checklist_id": item.checklist_id,
                 "description": item.description,
                 "category": item.category,
                 "is_mandatory": item.is_mandatory,
                 "is_completed": item.is_completed,
                 "completed_by": item.completed_by,
                 "completed_at": item.completed_at,
                 "evidence_document_id": item.evidence_document_id,
             }
             for item in items
         ],
     }
 
 
 def list_project_checklists_service(
     db: Session,
     project_id: uuid.UUID,
     page: int = 1,
     page_size: int = 20,
 ) -> tuple[list[dict], int, int, int]:
     query = db.query(ComplianceChecklist).filter(ComplianceChecklist.project_id == project_id)
     total = query.count()
     checklists = (
         query.order_by(ComplianceChecklist.created_at.desc())
         .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
         .limit(page_size)
         .all()
     )
 
     items = [_checklist_to_read(c) for c in checklists]
     return items, total, page, page_size
 
 
 def instantiate_checklist_service(
     db: Session,
     project_id: uuid.UUID,
     data: InstantiateChecklistRequest,
     actor_id: uuid.UUID,
 ) -> dict | None:
     template = db.query(ComplianceTemplate).filter(ComplianceTemplate.id == data.template_id).first()
     if not template:
         return None
 
     items_data = []
     if template.items:
         try:
             items_data = json.loads(template.items) if isinstance(template.items, str) else template.items
         except Exception:
             items_data = []
 
     checklist = ComplianceChecklist(
         project_id=project_id,
         template_id=template.id,
         status=ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value,
     )
     db.add(checklist)
     db.flush()
 
     for item_data in items_data:
         item = ChecklistItem(
             checklist_id=checklist.id,
             description=item_data.get("description", ""),
             category=item_data.get("category"),
             is_mandatory=item_data.get("is_mandatory", False),
             is_completed=False,
         )
         db.add(item)
 
     db.commit()
     db.refresh(checklist)
 
     checklist_items = db.query(ChecklistItem).filter(ChecklistItem.checklist_id == checklist.id).all()
     checklist.items = checklist_items
 
     return _checklist_to_read(checklist)
 
 
 def get_checklist_service(db: Session, checklist_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:

     if data.is_completed:
         item.completed_by = actor_id
-        item.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        item.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
     else:

         item.completed_at = None

     checklist = db.query(ComplianceChecklist).filter(ComplianceChecklist.id == checklist_id).first()
     if checklist:

             db.query(ChecklistItem).filter(ChecklistItem.checklist_id == checklist_id).all()
